# TypeScript 5 with ES2022 Instructions

## TypeScript Configuration
- Target: ES2022
- Module: ESNext
- Strict mode enabled
- Modern JavaScript features available

## Best Practices
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Leverage ES2022 features (top-level await, class fields, etc.)
- Properly type all functions and variables
- Use modern async/await patterns
- Implement proper error handling

## Available ES2022 Features
- Class fields (public and private)
- Static class fields and methods
- Private methods and accessors
- Top-level await
- RegExp match indices
- Array.prototype.at()
- Object.hasOwn()
- Error cause

## Project Guidelines
- Follow functional programming patterns where appropriate
- Use TypeScript type inference when clear
- Define explicit types for function parameters and return values
- Leverage union and intersection types
- Use generics for reusable components
